### ❓ The Question
What is the specific technical unknown we are trying to solve? (e.g., "How to stream solver scores to Python via WebSockets?").

### 🎯 Goals / Objectives
- [ ] Research available libraries/frameworks.
- [ ] Create a "Proof of Concept" (POC) in a separate branch.
- [ ] Document the "Go/No-Go" decision.

### 🏁 Outcome
What does success look like? (e.g., "A decision on which library to use for the dashboard").

### 📖 References
Link to articles, stack-overflow, or library docs.
